bar_RobotArms_NullSector.id: an integer uniquely identifying the stock type
bar_RobotArms_NullSector.department: the Department object associated with the stock type
bar_RobotArms_NullSector.name: a string describing this type of stock; unique per manufacturer
bar_RobotArms_NullSector.abv: an optional Decimal giving the alcohol by volume
bar_RobotArms_NullSector.fullname: manufacturer, name and abv combined into a single string
bar_RobotArms_NullSector.price: the sale price as a Decimal, including VAT where appropriate, for a sale_unit_name of this type of stock
bar_RobotArms_NullSector.logo: the path to a PNG logo, or null if not present
bar_RobotArms_NullSector.tasting_notes: tasting notes as HTML, or null if not present
bar_RobotArms_NullSector.base_units_bought: the amount of stock bought in base units as a Decimal
bar_RobotArms_NullSector.base_units_remaining: the amount of stock remaining in base units as a Decimal
bar_RobotArms_NullSector.base_unit_name: a string giving the unit in which we count how much of this stock we have bought and sold, e.g. pint or ml
bar_RobotArms_NullSector.sale_unit_name: a string giving the unit in which we sell this type of stock, e.g. bottle or pint
bar_RobotArms_NullSector.base_units_per_sale_unit: the number of base units per sale unit as a Decimal
bar_RobotArms_NullSector.stock_unit_name: a string giving the unit in which we count this type of stock, e.g. pint or 1l carton
bar_RobotArms_NullSector.base_units_per_stock_unit: the number of base units per stock unit as a Decimal
bar_RobotArms_NullSector.stocklines: a list of stockline-brief objects describing places stock of this type is being sold

LoRaWAN._comment: this is the firehose of events from EMFs LoRaWAN system, which is running on ChirpStack.

weather_hq_topic.tempin: Temperature in the HQ cabin in degrees Celsius.
weather_hq_topic.humidityin: Humidity in the HQ cabin in %RH.
weather_hq_topic.windspeed: Wind average speed in miles per hour.
weather_hq_topic.windgust: Wind gust speed in miles per hour.
weather_hq_topic.maxdailygust: Maximum daily wind gust speed in miles per hour.
weather_hq_topic.rainrate: Rainfall in mm of last ten minutes x6 (hourly forecast).
weather_hq_topic.eventrain: Total rainfall since last zero reading in mm.
weather_hq_topic.hourlyrain: Total rainfall over the previous hour in mm.
weather_hq_topic.dailyrain: Total rainfall over the previous day in mm.
weather_hq_topic.weeklyrain: Total rainfall over the previous week in mm.
weather_hq_topic.feelslike: Feels like temperature in degrees Celsius (temp must be above 26.7).
weather_hq_topic.heatindex: Heat index in degrees Celsius (temp must be above 26.7).
weather_hq_topic.windchill: Wind chill (temp must be below 12 and windspeed above 3).

overbrewed_game.overbrewed/coffees: Published each time a cup is served, with what was in that cup and the total number of coffees served to date.
overbrewed_game.overbrewed/scoreboard/latest: Published each time a team completes the game, with their score.
